href.description: Opens this URL in a new tab

layout.description: Default "vertical". "horizontal" puts the image on the left

EntityCard.description: A card for one thing (a product, place, person or listing): an image, title, subtitle, description, a price or meta line, a badge, a rating and up to three buttons. href opens a page, and onClick is sent when it is bound. Use a Grid of EntityCards for several things.

onClick.description: Sent when the user clicks the card and it has no href.

onAction.description: Sent when the user clicks a button without href. The args carry the label of the button.

label.description: The label of the clicked button

href.description: Opens this URL instead of the full-screen view

layout.description: Default "grid". "bento" makes the first image twice as large

ImageGrid.description: A gallery of images in a grid. A click opens the image full-screen, with arrows to the other images. layout "bento" makes the first image twice as large.
